description: Create a form (as a draft). Give a plain-language description and Datronis designs the questions, or pass exact questions, or start from a template. The form is checked like any human-made form and cannot ask for passwords, card numbers, one-time codes or recovery phrases. Call publish_form to make it live. Requires the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

description.description: Describe the form in plain words and Datronis designs it (recommended).

language.description: Language to write the form in, e.g. "en", "fa", "de". Default "en".

questions.description: Exact questions to use instead of (or with no) description.

correct.description: Quiz mode: correct option texts, or a number.

options.description: Choices for choice/ranking types; statements for likert.

type.description: Question type: short_text, long_text, email, phone, url, number, single_choice, multiple_choice, dropdown, yes_no, ranking, matrix, rating, opinion_scale, nps, slider, likert, date, time, datetime, date_range, file_upload, audio, video, address, consent.

template.description: Start from a gallery template key, e.g. "job_application", "nps", "course_quiz", "event_rsvp".

name: create_form
